title: Conformal Geometry and Spectral Bounds on Manifolds with Boundary
summary: This work investigates upper bounds for the spectrum of the Steklov-type operator on Riemannian manifolds with boundary. We extend the Fraser-Schoen estimate for the first positive Steklov eigenvalue to higher Steklov eigenvalues, in terms of the relative conformal volume and the isoperimetric ratio.
